items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps the face feeling clean without stripping or over-drying oilier skin.
A light barrier moisturizer helps the skin feel comfortably hydrated and balanced.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is the simplest way to protect the look of young skin over the years.

response.routine_note: I removed the Vitamin C serum and Peptide Firming Cream because anti-aging products are made for mature skin and aren't needed at 15, and your scan shows a smooth-looking appearance; cleanse, moisturize and apply sunscreen every morning, and moisturize again at night. If you have any skin concerns that bother you, a dermatologist is the best person to ask.
